workspaceIntro: Draw on the canvas, switch tools on the left, and open Layers, Templates or Properties from the bottom bar.
menuText: Open the top-left menu to create or save a project, import or export SVG, adjust zoom, or open Advanced Settings.
libraryText: Tap the home button to return to your projects. Open a saved design or use the + card to create one.
historyText: Use the top-right arrows to undo or redo an action. Unavailable buttons appear dimmed.
generateText: Prepare a closed outline and the generation settings, then tap the puzzle button at the top right.
toolsText: The eight drawing and editing tools run down the left side, in the order listed below.
panelsText: The bottom bar opens Layers, Slot Templates and Properties. Pull a panel up to see more, then tap Done to return to the canvas.
toolsTitle: Switch tools and open their options
toolsIntro: Select an object to reveal its actions. Tap the selected Pencil tool again to adjust smoothness.
selectionText: Use the expanded selection bar for multi-select, select all, grouping, copying and deleting. Available actions depend on the selection.
pencilText: Move the slider between Accurate and Smooth. The triangle shown here was drawn with the Bézier tool; it is not a Pencil stroke.
parametersIntro: Deselect objects on the canvas, then open Properties from the bottom bar to set the canvas and puzzle-generation parameters.
inspectorIntro: Select an object on the canvas, then open Properties from the bottom bar to adjust its position, size and appearance.
templateIntro: Follow iPhone Demo Tab from the template library through drawing and point editing to the saved template.
templateDrawText: Tap + in Slot Templates and enter iPhone Demo Tab. Tap successive points in the drawing area to create an open path; double-tap to finish.
templateEditText: Tap Edit Points to reveal the six anchors in this example. Finish Editing returns to drawing mode; Save keeps the named template.
templateSavedText: Search for iPhone in the library, then tap iPhone Demo Tab to select the saved template. The example is an open polyline; its dimensions describe the path, not a finished puzzle piece.
generationIntro: Compare the same closed triangle before and after generation, then inspect the editable paths in Layers.
layersText: Open Layers from the bottom bar and expand Generated Jigsaw. Tap a path to select it; the controls on the right change its lock and visibility. 104 items counts children in the group, not individual puzzle pieces.
exportText: Choose Export SVG in the editor menu, confirm the filename and location, then tap Save. Exporting artwork requires Premium.
importText: Choose Import SVG in the editor menu and select a file. This example reopens the exported SVG in a new project, preserving its outline and internal cutlines.
settingsText: Open Advanced Settings from the editor menu. Expand the relevant group to adjust editor, saving or iCloud preferences, then apply the changes.
landscapeTitle: Turn your iPhone for a wider canvas
landscapeIntro: In landscape, the same tools move to the top and the panels share a collapsible sidebar on the left.
landscapeTools: Drawing tools run across the top. Menu, project library and sidebar controls sit on the left; undo, redo and generation stay on the right.
landscapeSidebar: Open the sidebar and use its bottom tabs for Layers, Slot Templates and Properties. Close it with the button at its upper right to free more canvas space.
